sloka: तेषां वृक्षांश्च शैलांश्च शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।अतिकायो महातेजाश्चिच्छेदास्त्रविदां वरः ।। ६.७१.४० ।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ vṛkṣāṁśca śailāṁśca śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ।atikāyo mahātejāścicchedāstravidāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.71.40 ।।

translations.english: Atikaya, endowed with extraordinary energy, efficient in the use of weapons, shattered the trees and rocks hurled by the Vanaras with his arrows adorned with gold.
